politicaPrivacidad.version: Version {{version}} — draft for the master's thesis, not written by legal counsel.
politicaPrivacidad.queDatosTexto: Your email, the name you give us when registering, and the entries you record in the categories you turn on (date of birth, gender if you provide it, time zone, and your per-category check-ins).
politicaPrivacidad.datosSensiblesTexto: Some categories (sex, sport/health, spirituality) count as special category data under GDPR (art. 9). They're only turned on and recorded with your explicit consent, which you can withdraw at any time by turning the category off.
politicaPrivacidad.paraQueTexto: Only to give you your own tracking dashboard and personalized suggestions inside the app. It is never shared with third parties or used for advertising.
politicaPrivacidad.tusDerechosTexto: You can access, correct, or delete your data at any time from your profile. Turning a category off does not delete its history — use data export/deletion if you want to erase everything.
politicaPrivacidad.contactoTexto: This is an academic project (master's thesis) — for any question about your data, contact the project's developer directly.

entrevista.descripcion: Let's have a relaxed chat. Tick the categories you want to follow and tell me how you feel in each. You can come back any time to change your categories or your scores: every change is saved as a new record and your history is kept.
entrevista.elegirAlgo: Tick at least one category to start.
entrevista.exito: Changes saved. Thanks for looking at yourself honestly.
entrevista.sinCambios: Change a score to be able to save.
entrevista.sensiblesExplicacion: They contain sensitive data. Before turning one on we'll ask for your consent and you can read the privacy policy; you can turn it off any time.
entrevista.descripcionActualizar: Has anything changed since last time? Review your answers and change only what you want. Every change is saved as a new record and your history is kept.

admin.sinPermiso: You don't have permission to view this page.
admin.catalogoAyuda: New categories appear, inactive, in every user's interview. Retiring one hides it and deactivates it for everyone, but scores already saved are kept.
admin.anadirDatosSensibles: Contains sensitive data (will ask for consent and can't be changed later)
admin.errorGuardar: The operation could not be completed
admin.retirarTexto: It will stop being offered and will be deactivated for all users. Scores already saved are kept.

dialogoTexto.role: The role determines what they can do in the app. You can only change other people's role, never your own.
dialogoTexto.email: Changes the email they sign in with (for example, to fix a typo). It will be recorded in the audit log.
dialogoTexto.name: Fixes the name shown on their profile.
dialogoTexto.suspend: They won't be able to sign in or use an open session, but all their data is kept. You can reactivate the account any time.
dialogoTexto.delete: Their profile, categories, consents, scores and login account will be erased. This can't be undone.
dialogoTexto.recovery: An email is sent with a link to choose a new password. You never see or set their password.
dialogoTexto.create: The account is created with a random temporary password that you'll see only once. Hand it to the person; they should change it with “Forgot my password”.

admin.contrasenaTemporalAviso: Temporary password: shown only now. Copy it before closing, it can't be shown again.
admin.contrasenaTemporalConsejo: Advise the person to change it as soon as they can.
admin.errorEmailEnUso: That email is already in use.
admin.errorRegla: Action not allowed: there must always be an administrator, and you can't act on yourself or on another administrator without demoting them first.
admin.errorNoEncontrado: That user was not found (they may no longer exist).
admin.errorDatos: Check the data: something is not valid.
admin.auditoriaAyuda: Latest admin actions. Only ids and the action are stored, never passwords or emails.

datos.exportarTexto: A JSON file with everything we hold about you: your account, profile, categories, consents and all your scores with their notes.
datos.errorExportar: Your data could not be exported
datos.eliminarTexto: Deletes your account and everything linked to it: profile, categories, consents and scores. It's your right and free of charge, but it can't be undone.
datos.dialogoTexto: This can't be undone. Your profile, categories, consents and all your scores and notes will be erased, and you won't be able to sign in with this email again. If you want to keep anything, download your data first.
datos.errorEliminar: The account could not be deleted
datos.errorUltimoAdmin: You are the only administrator and there must always be one: you can't delete your account until you create another administrator (by granting the role to another account).

recomendaciones.aviso: These ideas are general wellbeing suggestions and do not replace professional medical, financial or psychological advice.

economia.1: If you feel like it, note down where your money goes for a week, without judging yourself: just looking already helps.
economia.2: Try setting aside a small amount as soon as you're paid, even a symbolic one. The habit is what matters.

vidaSocial.1: Write today to someone you haven't spoken to in a while: a short message is enough to reconnect.
vidaSocial.2: Suggest a simple plan this week, like a coffee or a walk with someone you feel good around.

pareja.1: Set aside a screen-free moment this week to be together, even if it's only twenty minutes.
pareja.2: Tell your partner something you've appreciated about them lately; small details add up.

sexo.1: Talking calmly about what you like or feel uncomfortable with often helps; pick a moment with no rush and no pressure.
sexo.2: Take some time to look after yourself and find out what feels good, with no goals or expectations.

deporte.1: Go for a twenty-minute walk today: starting small beats not starting.
deporte.2: Pick an activity you enjoy and put it in your calendar twice this week.

aventura.1: Change one small routine this week: a different route, a new dish, a place you don't know.
aventura.2: Write down a plan you're excited about, even a small one, and give it a date.

espiritualidad.1: Give yourself five minutes of silence a day, phone away, to be with yourself.
espiritualidad.2: Write down what gives you meaning lately and what you'd like to nurture more.

familia.1: Call someone in your family this week just to ask how they are.
familia.2: Suggest a meal or some time together: sometimes a small initiative is enough.

inversiones.1: Spend half an hour reviewing where your money is and what each part is for.
inversiones.2: Read up from reliable sources on one basic idea, like diversification, before deciding anything.

general.1: Pick one small action related to {{categoria}} that you can do this week and write it down.
general.2: Think about what weighs on you most in {{categoria}} and which small change would ease it.
general.3: Ask yourself what would help most right now in {{categoria}} and take a first step, however small.
